changes.reason: Add an alpha application-owned AWS S3 StorageProvider with namespaced objects, ranged streams, signed GET URLs, credential-chain configuration and bounded awaited multipart cleanup.

kubernetes.reason: Use one AWS SDK S3 adapter under the Node Host; local HTTP/Host execution does not verify cluster identity or AWS authorization.
constraints: Node networking and valid bucket/prefix-scoped IAM are required.
Operator owns IRSA/OIDC trust, projected token rotation, optional Secret references and incomplete multipart expiration.
Live Kubernetes, STS/S3 and workload identity authentication remain unverified.

aws-lambda.reason: Reuse the Node SDK through the Lambda Host with default execution-role credentials; no credentials or infrastructure are provisioned.
constraints: Await uploads and bounded independent multipart cleanup before returning; consume or cancel streams.
Reuse the application/client across warm invocations and dispose only after drain. Reserve cleanupTimeoutMs in the host deadline.
Live Lambda role permissions, deployment, network reachability and AWS S3 remain unverified.

cloudflare.reason: This adapter uses the Node AWS SDK path; Worker isolate support is not implemented or claimed.
constraints: Use a separately reviewed Workers-native storage adapter. Node Container deployment is not assessed by this change.
